positive_snippets:
Had an absolutely wonderful experience at this beautiful boutique resort in Manesar! From the moment we arrived, everything felt warm, elegant, and perfectly managed.
The staff is incredibly polite, helpful, and attentive — they truly make you feel special. A special mention to Jolly at breakfast buffet & Nikhil at Reception for the amazing hospitality and care. Your kindness and professionalism made our experience even more memorable.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a luxurious and heartwarming experience in Manesar. Will definitely visit again! 🌸✨

This was our second visit to Karma Lakelands within three months, and that itself says a lot. The first time didn’t feel like enough, and we already know we’ll keep coming back.

Just 20–30 minutes from Gurgaon, yet it feels miles away from the city chaos… With a no-honking zone, abundant greenery, minimal construction, and open spaces, the air feels noticeably fresher… even during NCR winters. It’s incredibly peaceful and quiet inside.

The property is vast and thoughtfully designed, with golf greens, walking tracks, a serene lake with boating, and experiential tours that help you explore different villas and spaces within Karma.

A special mention to Mr. Nikesh, our buggy driver, who was extremely warm and helpful and even went out of his way to arrange a boat ride for us… The staff overall is welcoming and pleasant.

We also loved Under the Neem, a beautiful café with unique dishes that’s popular even with visitors from outside… The Karma Club area, children’s play zones, and walking tracks make the experience feel wholesome and enriching.

Highly recommend Karma Lakelands if you’re looking for a peaceful, refreshing escape close to Gurgaon.

Karma Chalets is a nice weekend getaway place not too far away from the bustling city life. It's an hour drive from Gurgaon and the property is set within lush green scenery with plenty of flora and fauna for the nature enthusiasts. It's a family friendly place with decent restaurants within the property, a small kids play area and with plenty photo spots (those who care about aesthetics). Although on the expensive side, it's a very good stay with excellent service.
negative_snippets:
Unfortunately, we had an underwhelming experience at Karma Chalets, during our anniversary stay. While the rooms are clean, they are extremely small for the price point. In fact, the pricing is comparable to five-star hotels, which makes the value feel unjustified.

The ambience, service, room quality, and overall experiences were fairly average and did not meet the expectations set by the high Google ratings. I genuinely don’t understand how it is rated so highly, as the property itself feels quite ordinary.

That said, the staff deserves special mention — they were warm, polite, and genuinely pleasant throughout our stay, which was the only real highlight.

Overall, while cleanliness and staff are strong points, the property and experience do not justify the premium pricing.

Room was fine, was actually a villa with more than one room for a family stay kind of set up but the kitchenette disn5have anything useful, just a refrigerator and dip tea. An induction stove with a few utensils would have made the place much useful but I think they prioritize making money over the guest comfort. Service was slow and I would say bad, cleaning guys wouldn't keep a hand towel in the washrooms unless asked multiple times, food quantity varied over three days when ordered in the room and they will completely slip something out of that order and wouldn't bring even after follow ups. The service at their dine-in was much better as Grace and Jolly served with smile and ensured you get everything you needed.
Location is good, nestled under a lot of trees and open area. Just that winters may not be the best time to go as they shared the same air as the rest of the Delhi-NCT.
